title: Manifesto Watch 2027
role: Head of Communications and Public Relations, CAGAD
description: Lead communications and advocacy for an EU-supported democratic accountability initiative through PLAC. The Publish Your Manifesto campaign calls for timely publication of political party manifestos. Recruitment results are programme outputs; electoral or policy outcomes are not yet established.

title: LogaLab
description: Co-founded a civic technology initiative to make fiscal information accessible. Mobilised approximately ten collaborators and organised two training sessions. The Bayelsa pilot is under development; Civic Hive and ACE fellowship support was organisational, represented by my co-founder. No grant funding has been received.

title: Fiscal transparency
role: State Fiscal Transparency League Fellow, BudgIT
description: Analyse budget implementation, expenditure priorities and disclosure, primarily in Bayelsa. Recommendations are analytical outputs, not evidence of policy adoption.

title: Vote Beta
description: Led non-partisan voter sensitisation in Bayelsa and Rivers and participated in consultations with INEC, security agencies and civil society. The reported outreach figure is not a measure of changes in turnout.

title: INEC Vanguard CDS
description: Coordinated voter education in Oke-Ila Orangun and surrounding communities through markets, religious institutions, town halls, posters and radio. The conservative outreach estimate is based on programme reports and community population estimates.

title: Education and humanitarian partnerships
role: Communications and Publicity Manager, Spelling Bee Bayelsa
metrics: NGN 5 million+ in organisational cash and in-kind contributions
description: Secured Century Group as a sponsor and IdentityPass as a relief partner. The organisation mobilised resources for scholarships and school materials; a separate relief initiative received approximately NGN 1 million and provided welfare items in Benue.

title: Cross-cultural leadership in Morocco
metrics: 45,000+ digital impressions across four consortium events
description: Supported HCI workshop communications, led climate innovation communications and managed Climate Fresk 2026. These initiatives brought together students across Morocco and Africa.
